review.note: Approved one by one in define-gate slot G3-05 of the resolution-recipe-eval package (REQ-224 exception (b)); the docs PR carrying the answered slot merged 2026-10-10.

question: My Grizzly Bears has a +1/+1 counter on it, and I cast Giant Growth on it. After Giant Growth resolves, my opponent casts Turn to Frog on it. How big is it once Turn to Frog resolves?

expected.shortAnswer: 5/5: Turn to Frog sets the base to 1/1, then Giant Growth's +3/+3 and the counter's +1/+1 still apply.
expected.answer: It's a 5/5 blue Frog with no abilities for the rest of the turn. Turn to Frog sets its base power and toughness to 1/1, which applies in layer 7b (613.4b). Giant Growth's +3/+3 and the +1/+1 counter modify power and toughness, which applies in layer 7c (613.4c), always after 7b no matter which effect started first. So 1/1 plus 3/3 plus 1/1 makes 5/5.

whyHard: Setting base power and toughness (7b) always applies before modifiers and counters (7c), so the order the spells were cast in does not matter.
